glosses: Lacking the F factor, and able to receive DNA from another bacterium which does have this factor (a male).

examples.text: In this process, one bacterium designated the male bacterium transfers its DNA into the female bacterium. Bacteria with this small piece of DNA are labeled as males, and bacteria that do not have this factor are considered females.
